messages:
marie (oncall): IncidentBot triggered P1 for pharos-eu-dedicated-01 — sudden 5xx spike, started 09:12 UTC. Paging SRE.
IncidentBot: page sent to @marie, severity=P1, alert_id=inc-3991234567. Symptom: 503s for inference endpoints, p95 latency up.
jordan (eng-sre): reading logs now. seeing a surge of grpc 'connection reset' and 502 translation in the edge.
marie (oncall): quick checklist — scale autoscaler, check GPU pool health, confirm model variants. tagging runbook.
marie (oncall): Runbook ref: /runbooks/dedicated-5xx -> step 1: verify pool, step2: restart router, step3: failover. I'll start step 1.
jordan (eng-sre): logs: binder daemon OOM kill on node eu-node-07. kv-cache pressure evident. isolating node and removing from pool.
alex (acct): pinging Pharos primary contacts by phone now. Leaving a note that we're investigating and will send targeted status. Lia, can you craft a short tailored impact blurb for them?
lia (customer-success): draft for Pharos (tailored): "We're investigating elevated 5xx errors in EU affecting model-led features (analytics ingestion, embeddings). Some requests may return 503 or delayed responses. We're failing over capacity and will update within 30 minutes. Contact: alex@redwood for direct updates."
ops_comm: status page draft (short):
```\nSummary: We are investigating elevated server errors affecting EU dedicated instances for a subset of enterprise customers. Impact: Intermittent 503 responses and increased latency. Affected customers: PharosAnalytics (primary), NovaMetrics (possible). ETA: initial mitigation in 15-30m.``` 
marie (oncall): running `kubectl cordon eu-node-07 && kubectl drain eu-node-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` to take node OOS. scaling pool +2 while drain proceeds.
devops_lead: agree to scale and also prepare failover to us-west-dedicated-03. Note: failover increases e2e latency ~150-300ms for Pharos queries. Need ack from Alex for customer ops.
alex (acct): ack, I've left voicemail for Pharos SRE and emailed on-call distribution. They asked for triage notes and an interim workaround to route heavy embedding jobs to US.
jordan (eng-sre): applied temporary routing rule: route pharos customer_id=pharos-prod to us-west-dedicated-03 for non-priority inference. Verified 200 response rate on test requests.
lia (customer-success): I'll send the tailored email to Pharos now. Draft below — please confirm:
"Hi Ana,
We're actively investigating elevated 5xx errors impacting your EU dedicated instance. Mitigation: we are failing over non-priority traffic to our us-west pool which should stabilize responses; some requests may see higher latency. We will follow up with a full post-incident summary. For urgent questions, contact alex@redwood or call +1-555-0102."
marie (oncall): ops_comm please push that status page update and mark affected components: EU dedicated serving, routing layer. Add note about workaround.
ops_comm: status page updated to reflect mitigation and impacted components. also created incident ticket on status: INC-3991234567.
marie (oncall): handoff: I'm handing on-call to jordan at 09:35 UTC — node OOS, routing rule in place, scaling in progress. jordan, can you own customer comms follow-through and postmortem assignment?
jordan (eng-sre): taking over on-call. I'll continue root cause & coordinate postmortem. action list: 1) verify all affected nodes removed, 2) validate failover stability, 3) capture logs for OOM chain, 4) prepare internal RCA draft.
alex (acct): Pharos confirmed they see improved success rate after routing; they accepted temporary latency tradeoff. They've asked for a one-page impact blurb for their execs — lia will send.
lia (customer-success): sent tailored exec blurb to Ana and cc'd alex. Closing loop with them and offering a dedicated postmortem call.
marie (oncall): closing immediate paging actions. follow-up items assigned in incident ticket INC-3991234567. I'll be available if needed. :thumbsup:
note: This thread contains the initial alert, short action items, status page/email drafts, customer contact routing decisions, and an on-call handoff for a P1 affecting an enterprise customer's dedicated EU instance.
